actual_scope: Explicit 208-primitive signed Hadamard four-source/four-output construction using ten restoring source queries and twelve readouts, with arbitrary dirty connector and all child scratch restored.

stop_rule: Stop at the first strict verified improvement over the cited 222 primitive construction, or after at most 100000 sampled paths and the session budget.
